newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks close stronger on local buying.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks close stronger on local buying.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed higher on Friday led by local buying of manufacturing and finance shares, which are expected to benefit most from Wednesday's budget, brokers said.
The all share closed 2.44 points up at 623.11. Ceylon Brewery rose two rupees to 33.25, Richard Pieris Exports 2.50 to 23.50, Lanka Ceramic 1.50 to 32.50.
"There is no doubt that buying by local investors is on the rise after the budget," said Prashan Fernando a broker at Forbes and Walker Stock Brokers.
